occupancy.title: Configure occupancy controller
occupancy.description:
Create a room occupancy controller using trigger and sustain entities. The name is used for the controller device and primary occupancy sensor.

Trigger entities START occupancy. Use PIR or motion entities that should mark the room occupied when they turn on. If any triggers are configured, sustain entities cannot start occupancy while the room is vacant.

Sustain entities KEEP occupancy active. Use mmWave, presence, BLE, media, computer-activity, or similar on/off entities. If no triggers are configured, a sustain entity can also start occupancy; occupancy ends when all sustain entities turn off.

For trigger-only configurations, set a decay time so occupancy ends after the last trigger.

For configuration help, see: {github_url}

data.trigger_entities: Trigger entities (optional): start occupancy when any turns on. Best for PIR or motion sensors:
data.decay_minutes: Trigger-only decay time (required when no sustain entities are configured):
data.sustain_entities: Sustain entities (optional): keep occupancy active while any are on. If no triggers are configured, sustains can also start occupancy:
data.required_on_entities: Required ON entities (optional): all must be on for occupancy to start or remain active:
data.required_off_entities: Required OFF entities (optional): all must be off for occupancy to start or remain active:

error.occupancy_and_auto_off: Occupancy sensor and automatic off cannot be used together.
error.occupancy_needs_entity: Specify at least one trigger entity or sustain entity.
error.trigger_only_needs_minutes: Trigger-only occupancy requires a decay time because no sustain entities are configured.

missing_reference.title: Smartify entity reference is missing
missing_reference.description: **{controller}** references `{entity_id}` as **{roles}**, but that entity does not exist in Home Assistant. Correct the entity ID in the Smartify configuration, then reload or restart Smartify.

wrong_reference_domain.title: Smartify controlled entity has the wrong domain
wrong_reference_domain.description: **{controller}** references `{entity_id}` as **{roles}**, but this controller requires an entity in the `{expected_domain}` domain. Correct the Smartify configuration, then reload or restart Smartify.
